profile: Guard Therapeutics International AB is a Swedish clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing therapies for kidney disease. Its lead candidate, RMC-035, is being studied to protect the kidneys from injury in settings such as open-heart surgery, and the company also develops preclinical peptide-based programs derived from alpha-1-microglobulin. In June 2026, it announced a conditional reverse takeover with Disruptive Pharma.
